rule_outs: Dwelling 7 m from the best section
summary: Apartment blocks line the whole west kerb, 6-8 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks directly beside the kerb along the full length; the nearest is 6-8 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parallel parking, cars parked on this side; room to stop is fine.
drivers.traffic: Quiet inner-suburban street, with retail nearby to the north.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it, but signs are 2P Mon-Fri 7am-5pm and No Stopping Any Time at both ends.

sun_shade: Street trees on the south part shade the kerb; apartments shade the west side in the afternoon.

best_section.where: West kerb of Clarence Road beside the southern apartment block, just north of the junction
